coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your north star is payment success rate, and every slow or failed call hurts it. At Lumen Payments I faced a similar problem when the payment status API was too slow under load. I moved the hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis and cut p99 latency from 480 ms to 120 ms.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Lumen Payments, I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, processing about 40 million events a day on Kafka. I also led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, which is the service-oriented architecture work your Payments team does. I was on call for the payments platform and wrote the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents, so owning production services end to end is familiar ground. My 11 years of backend work in Java, Kotlin and Python, plus API design, code review, mentoring and Datadog monitoring, map to the scalable APIs and reliability work in this role. I haven't written production Go, but I've built high-volume services in other JVM languages and I pick up new languages quickly. After a planned career break to care for a family member, I'm back to full-time engineering and ready to take on your self-serve payment platform.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I can help Coinbase get new payment methods live faster. I'm available to start talking at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

Hello Coinbase Hiring Team,

At Lumen Payments I designed and ran the settlement service that processed about 40 million events a day on Kafka, and I led a team of 4 engineers through the move from a monolith to 6 services. That's the kind of fault-tolerant payments work your Payments Platform team does, backed by 11 years of backend engineering and on-call ownership of a live payments platform. I've attached my CV and cover letter so you can see the details. I'm returning to full-time engineering and can start a conversation any weekday this week or next.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
